name: Judgmental People
overview: Scripture warns against hypocritical and unrighteous judgment, emphasizing that those who judge others will themselves be judged by the same standard (Matthew 7:1-2). Jesus condemns the desire to be seen by men in religious acts (Matthew 6:5) and instructs believers to judge with righteous discernment rather than by outward appearances (John 7:24). The call to humility is reinforced by Jesus’ challenge that only those without sin may judge others (John 8:7), reminding us that true entrance into God's kingdom depends on doing the Father's will, not merely on outward profession (Matthew 7:21).
